47/S0.subgoal: Explain the purpose, objectives, and empirical evaluation method for the Majuli VR tour case study.

47/S1.subgoal: Describe the participants and hardware setup used in the Majuli VR tour evaluation experiment.

47/S2.subgoal: Describe the questionnaires and rating scales used to measure presence and cyber sickness.
